about_the_game:
In Galaxy Critter Co., you will become a brave little animal leader, traveling across multiple planets to clear out invading swarms using high-tech turrets, weapons, and soldiers. Fueled by your fluffy determination, you’ll utilize your unique talents in battle to earn the prestigious 5-Star Member honor! On this epic journey to protect their home, these critters might even unravel the mystery behind the disappearance of human civilization…

Recruit a Variety of Animal Staff

From diligent bear engineer to the lone-wolf cat ranger, a diverse cast of animal employees with unique personalities is ready to join your team! Each employee comes with special skills and distinctive traits. By matching employees with compatible leaders and assigning roles strategically, you can create your dream team and let everyone shine on the battlefield!

Deploy Cutting-Edge Constructions

Victory requires more than just bravery! Construct high-tech turrets, functional buildings, and defensive structures during battles to maximize the use of limited resources. With defensive, offensive, and support buildings available, your strategies can become more diverse and dynamic than ever!

Shape Your Team’s Style

Will your employees face the swarm head-on in physical combat, or will you establish an automated tower defense line? Will you specialize in brute-force tactics or delve into advanced elemental technology? By purchasing enhancement modules and upgrading weapons, you can adapt your battle strategies and create a unique team style! Every battle will test the limits of your tactical genius.

Uncover the Secrets of the Universe

This is a chaotic yet adorable universe teeming with space swarms, silicon-based life, and small animal heroes. Why did human civilization mysteriously vanish? As battles intensify, the animals will gradually uncover the secrets hidden in the depths of the galaxy. The journey to protect their home will also become an adventure into the history of the universe.

name: Galaxy Critter Co.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 (SP1+)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 / AMD FX-6300 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon HD 7850 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: 1080p resolution recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: 1080p or higher resolution for smooth gameplay at 60 FPS

short_description: What do galaxy critters fear the most? — The Space Swarm! Who do you call to stop them? — Galaxy Critter Co.! Join Cubby and other fluffy operatives as they travel across planets to crush the swarm, protect the critters’ homes and uncover the mystery of humanity’s disappearance!
